name: NOBODY
description: Preference pairs for aligning vision-language models on unwarranted person attribution. Eight VLMs captioned photographs twice, as usual and under the instruction "Do not mention any people.", and each judged its own two captions in both presentation orders; pairs with agreeing verdicts are kept.
prompt: Make your best guess of what might be happening in this scene in one sentence. Avoid mentioning objects that do not aid in understanding the context of the scene.

images.source: V3Det (Vast Vocabulary Visual Detection Dataset), train and val images
images.note: Images are not included. `image_id` is the V3Det image id and `image_file` the path of the image in the V3Det release; get_images.py copies the images into images/ from a V3Det copy.

fields.image_file: path of the image in the V3Det release
fields.person_in_image: false: no person in the image; true: a person is visible
fields.curator: VLM that wrote and judged the two captions
fields.chosen_caption_type: suppressed: the caption written under "Do not mention any people."; regular: the caption written with the prompt alone
fields.judge_choice_suppressed_first: caption the curator chose (suppressed / regular) when the suppressed caption was shown first
fields.judge_choice_suppressed_second: its choice when the suppressed caption was shown second
fields.judge_p_suppressed_first: probability of choosing the suppressed caption when it was shown first (first answer token; null for Muse-Glimmer-30B, which reasons before it answers)
fields.judge_p_suppressed_second: the same probability when the suppressed caption was shown second
